calculation.expression: when lagged breadth20 > 0.45 and lagged VIX_change5 > lagged 120-session 60th percentile, -(asset_return10_lagged - cross_asset_mean_return10_lagged) / volatility40_lagged; otherwise 0; cross-sectionally demean
calculation.description: A broader stress-regime residual reversal. It reverses each asset's lagged ten-session return relative to the cross-asset mean, volatility-normalized, when at least 45% of assets have negative lagged twenty-session returns and VIX five-session change is elevated. Inputs are lagged to prevent look-ahead bias.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on the 15-instrument cross-asset universe with 505 valid IC dates and average 15.0 instruments per date. Chronological thirds of daily observations were 0.008936 and 0.014128 for the first two reported thirds; the final partial segment had no usable observations in this gate implementation. Interpret stability conservatively because the signal is regime-conditional.
